data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Contract documents which leaf owns dso-id label writes per direction x scenario: inbound_clean_label removes (draft-2); repair_property writes property (draft-6); per-element provenance skips dso-id (draft-9)

Add DsoIdLabelWriteError to plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_errors.py. Add _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({'inbound_clean_label', 'outbound_create'}) module-level constant to applier.py with verbose docstring documenting the per-leaf contract: explicitly names each of the 9 applier leaves; states that ONLY inbound_clean_label (delete) and outbound_create (create) may emit dso-id label mutations; inbound_repair_property writes property field NOT label; conflict_resolver per-element provenance must skip dso-id. Docstring IS the contract artifact for dd-1.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given the dso_reconciler package; When importing DsoIdLabelWriteError from _errors and _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS from applier; Then exception subclasses Exception, frozenset equals frozenset({'inbound_clean_label','outbound_create'}), and applier docstring mentions all 9 leaf names plus conflict_resolver and inbound_repair_property.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_errors.py plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py
- [ ] DsoIdLabelWriteError importable from _errors and Exception subclass
  Verify: python3 -c "from plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler._errors import DsoIdLabelWriteError; assert issubclass(DsoIdLabelWriteError, Exception)"
- [ ] _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS == frozenset({'inbound_clean_label','outbound_create'})
  Verify: python3 -c "from plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.applier import _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS; assert _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS == frozenset({'inbound_clean_label','outbound_create'})"
- [ ] Contract docstring mentions all 9 leaves + conflict_resolver + inbound_repair_property
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_errors.py::test_authorized_writers_docstring_documents_full_contract

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_errors.py — Edit
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py — Edit
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_errors.py — Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
